title: Fix the Unhandled Missing File
description: The program should attempt to read a file and handle the case where it doesn't exist.
expectedBehavior: If the file doesn't exist, the program should print a clear message instead of crashing with a stack trace.
actualProblem: The FileNotFoundException that FileReader throws for a missing file is declared with throws IOException on main, which only postpones the crash — it's never actually caught, so the program still terminates abruptly with an uncaught exception and stack trace.
explanation: Declaring throws on main only tells the compiler the exception is allowed to propagate — it does not handle it. Actually recovering from a missing file requires a try/catch around the code that might fail.
